components.name: Primary action
components.description: The next useful action, with contrast-safe hover and a clear focus ring.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:2.75rem;padding:0.625rem 1rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius,0.75rem);font:600 1rem/1.6 Inter,sans-serif;background:var(--primary,#F97316);color:var(--foreground,#3B2416);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--action-hover,#9A3412);color:var(--surface,#FFFFFF) } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--teal,#0F766E);outline-offset:3px } .ds-button:active { transform:translateY(1px) } .ds-button:disabled { background:var(--border,#EDE5D8);color:var(--secondary-text,#6B625B);cursor:not-allowed;transform:none } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none } .ds-button:active { transform:none } }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: A quieter action with a visible boundary.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:2.75rem;padding:0.625rem 1rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius,0.75rem);font:600 1rem/1.6 Inter,sans-serif;background:var(--primary,#F97316);color:var(--foreground,#3B2416);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--action-hover,#9A3412);color:var(--surface,#FFFFFF) } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--teal,#0F766E);outline-offset:3px } .ds-button:active { transform:translateY(1px) } .ds-button:disabled { background:var(--border,#EDE5D8);color:var(--secondary-text,#6B625B);cursor:not-allowed;transform:none } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none } .ds-button:active { transform:none } } .ds-outline { background:var(--surface,#FFFFFF);color:var(--foreground,#3B2416);border-color:var(--muted,#78716C) } .ds-outline:hover { background:var(--background,#FFFBF5);color:var(--foreground,#3B2416) }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A labeled native input in the shared Shadcn layer.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid;gap:0.5rem;font:600 1rem/1.6 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--foreground,#3B2416) } .ds-field input { min-height:2.75rem;padding:0.625rem 0.75rem;border:1px solid var(--muted,#78716C);border-radius:var(--radius,0.75rem);background:var(--surface,#FFFFFF);color:var(--foreground,#3B2416);font:400 1rem/1.6 Inter,sans-serif;caret-color:var(--teal,#0F766E) } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:var(--secondary-text,#6B625B) } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--teal,#0F766E);outline-offset:3px }

narrative.northStar: Community journal with a pet story feed
narrative.overview: An animal story is the useful center of PawTrail. Warm cream ground, white story surfaces, brown text, and recognizable animal identities connect community responses to practical help. Photography belongs to the content; clear names and native links carry identification across posts, profiles, maps, and help requests.
keyCharacteristics: Animal identity leads; supporting chrome stays compact.
Warm, flat surfaces with clear text and native interaction.
Honest sample labels, permissions, unavailable states, and recovery.
dos: Do keep pet identity, readable names, status words, and the next useful action together.
Do use shared primitives, safe return paths, truthful readiness, and visible recovery.
Do preserve all pinned brand tokens and test actual foreground/background pairs.
donts: Don't invent counts, balances, verification, testimonials, or rescue outcomes.
Don't expose unfinished destinations as working links.
Don't claim rendered visual verification from source or component tests.
